stories.title: Number of Australians missing in Nepal’s deadly floods rises again, as Albanese deploys more personnel
stories.summary: The figure rose to 41 on Saturday morning, with four rapid response teams to arrive in Kathmandu The number of Australians who were reported missing in the catastrophic Nepal flooding disaster has risen to 41, as one family celebrates after an unaccounted-for woman made contact with them yesterday. It means three additional Australians were confirmed missing overnight – up from 38 who remained unaccounted for on Friday evening. Continue reading...
stories.headline: Number of Australians missing in Nepal’s deadly floods rises again, as Albanese deploys more personnel

opening: The figure rose to 41 on Saturday morning, with four rapid response teams to arrive in Kathmandu.

The number of Australians who were reported missing in the catastrophic Nepal flooding disaster has risen to 41, as one family celebrates after an unaccounted-for woman made contact with them yesterday.
body: It means three additional Australians were confirmed missing overnight – up from 38 who remained unaccounted for on Friday evening.

stories.title: A candle against Hong Kong’s growing darkness
stories.summary: Chow Hang-tung, one of Hong Kong's most prominent political prisoners, has been behind bars for more than five years. Now she's facing another 10-year prison sentence.

stories.title: Gen Z vs the khap panchayats: Old rules, new rebels
stories.summary: Haryana’s khap panchayats have issued diktats against love marriages within a village cluster or clan, and live-in and same-sex relationships. If people do not abide by these, they will be barred from entering their villages, the khaps say. This has drawn strong opposition from Gen Z on social media. A section of the youth, both women and men, say the personal choices of consenting adults trump community custom. And that laws, rather than elderly men, protect women, reports Ashok Kumar
